facts.statement: The Realmskeepers left for Sunstone Valley to investigate a gang of chopper-riding Dwarves called the Skullz and disappeared; after a week without word, Madame Zelda asked the player to search for and rescue them.
facts.quote: Having heard no word from them for a week, she has once again called upon you to search for the Realmskeepers

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: An official Free Realms news post announcing the Rumbledome Trading Card Game set, which launched Thursday, March 21, 2013, with new game cards, virtual rewards and a quest line in Sunstone Valley. It also gives story context: Baron vonDarkcheat was defeated and the Realmskeepers went missing while investigating Sunstone Valley, and the player is asked to search for them, starting at Madame Zelda's camp in Blackspore Swamp. The page does not give the exact posting date; it says the post was made about 1 week and 19 hours before capture (2013-03-27).
